articleTitle: Research on the Application of Digital Twin in Bridge Rotation Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of China's high-speed railway network, the construction of bridges spanning existing railway lines has become increasingly common. Bridge transition, as a solution for constructing bridges on existing tracks, is crucial for ensuring safety during the construction phase. This research aims to utilize digital twin technology to monitor the construction of bridge transitions and address the limitations of traditional bridge monitoring methods. We employed the Unity3D game engine to create a digital twin virtual scene and facilitated seamless data exchange between the physical and virtual domains using the OPC UA data exchange mechanism. Ultimately, we developed a prototype system for monitoring bridge transition construction. This system effectively monitors critical information and activities during bridge construction, providing early warning capabilities and decision support throughout the construction process. Through the design and implementation of the system prototype, we have confirmed the feasibility of applying digital twin technology in bridge transition construction.

articleTitle: Anti-jamming Research of UAV Communication Based on Link-16 Datalink
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the context of Link-16 datalink UAV operation, aiming at the communication interference problem in UAV combat, taking the suppressive interference model as an example, the three-layer modeling model of UAV communication jammer based on Link-16, Link11 and Link-22 datalink is constructed on the OPNET software simulation platform. The model details the parameter meanings of each layer of the model, and uses suitable simulation scenarios for experimental verification. Through the comparative analysis of the experimental results, it is proved that Link-16 has strong anti-interference. The study of anti-jamming of Link-16 datalink has been a popular issue, and the experimental comparative study in this paper can provide a good understanding of the relevant communication capabilities of this datalink. Link-16’s stronger anti-jamming study lays the groundwork for subsequent jamming studies. Its unique immunity to jamming aids militarized warfare.

articleTitle: Quadrotor UAV Virtual Reality Verification Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: At present, quadrotor UAVs are widely used in various fields. A large number of tests are required to verify quadrotor UAVs before they are put into operation. However, the current simulation tests of quadrotor UAVs can't meet the testing requirements well. In order to solve this problem, this paper introduces the digital twin technology, builds a virtual reality verification platform for quadrotor UAVs based on digital twins, and elaborates on its architecture. By constructing a virtual mapping of the real environment in the twin space and using a combination of digital modeling and simulation modeling, real-time real-to-virtual mapping and real-time virtual-to-real intelligent control are realized. Finally, by designing experiments from real to imaginary and from imaginary to real, the analysis of the experimental results proves that the quadrotor UAV virtual reality verification platform can achieve real-time mapping of quadrotor UAV flight state as well as real-time reverse control. It is verified that the platform can effectively reduce the risk of quadrotor UAVs in the test process, thereby reducing the test cycle and cost of quadrotor UAVs.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-load AGV Scheduling Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In response to the problems of heavy workload and long handling time caused by manual forklift handling of parts in automobile manufacturing enterprises producing large parts, introduction of intelligent material handling robots, or "AGVs", to achieve intelligent logistics transportation in factories. Firstly, the shortest distance between each AGV and each work station is taken as the objective function, secondly, the AGV scheduling model is established whereas keeping in mind the double constraints of distribution time and load capacity, and finally, the improved genetic algorithm is used to solve and confirm the scheduling results. The results show that, when compared to the standard genetic algorithm, the improved genetic algorithm reduces total distance travelled by 20.19%, increases AGV loading rate by 23.75%, and meets the time window requirements, making the material distribution more timely.

articleTitle: Route Optimization in the Inbound Logistics Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Reasonable vehicle routing planning is the key of the inbound logistics management. The milk-run problem, which is different from traditional direct supply mode, can be seen as variety of vehicle routing problem. The milk-run mode is suitable for the transportation demand of parts with multi-varieties, multi-frequency, small batch. It improves the on-time delivery rate of parts. It is one of the most challenging problems in the optimization. Ant colony algorithm (ACA), an evolutionary algorithm, has been proved capable of solving milk-run problems. In this article, milk run is abstracted into vehicle routing problem with time window. Ant Colony Algorithm, in which the width of time window and waiting time of clients are introduced into state transition, is applied to milk-run problems. The experimental results indicate efficiency of the proposed algorithm strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Digital Signature in University Electronic Government System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This article analyzes the principles and processes of digital signature technology, as well as its application methods in the university e-government system. On the one hand, it meets the business management needs of university, and on the other hand, the application of digital signature and timestamp electronic signature ensures the security of university e-government SystemThe university e-government management system based on digital signature technology verifies the identity of users such as the sender and receiver of files, and issues digital certificates. The sender uses digital certificates for system authorization. Signs and encrypts confidential files such as documents through digital signatures to protecting the security of electronic file transmission. Upload the digitally signed and encrypted documents to the system, which completes the sending and receiving of the documents. On the one hand, the recipient downloads documents through the system and uses digital signatures to verify the integrity and authenticity of the documents. On the other hand, digitally sign the document and upload it to the system. Both parties complete the distribution and upload of documents through the system.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Power Spatiotemporal Big Data with Beidou Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of communication technology, the demand for remote transmission of massive data is getting higher and higher. The development of the BDS will greatly promote the high-speed transmission of information. Build a unified space-time information support framework based on Beidou, and make key breakthroughs in the aspects of timing, navigation, and short message communication. Globally measured positioning accuracy is better than 2.5 meters in the horizontal direction, and 5.0 meters in the vertical direction, velocity measurement accuracy is better than 0.2 meters/s, timing accuracy is better than 20 nanoseconds, and system availability is improved to 99%. This paper takes optical radio frequency (RoF) and Beidou blockchain as the core to research key technologies of power big data, which will provide strong technical support for better application in the analysis and transmission of power big data. The research results can be applied to many fields, which have important academic significance and practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on Line Loss Estimation Based on Improved K-Means++ and Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: A method based on improved K-Means++ and Elman neural network is proposed to calculate line loss for the problem of difficult computation and low accuracy of theoretical line loss in low-voltage(LV) station region. First, the Pearson correlation coefficient approach is utilized to identify and validate the main feature indicators of the LV station region. Second, the improved K-Means++ algorithm is used to cluster line loss data sets in the LV station region to increase the accuracy of line loss computation. In addition, the PSO algorithm is introduced to optimize the Elman neural network. Finally, simulations of real data and comparisons to existing calculation methods show that the proposed method has high training efficiency and calculation accuracy. The maximum percentage error of the suggested method is 1.15%, which is lower than the 6.07% of the BP neural network method.

articleTitle: Design and Engineering Analysis of Intelligent Display Rack
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In recent years, the output of monitor has been very high, but most of monitor can only be fixed on the desktop, but cannot adjust the vertical and horizontal direction of the position according to the real time need; As a result, people can only use the monitor in one position, and the body will be very uncomfortable when they use it for a long time. Via analysing the typical working conditions of the display and based on the principle scheme and functional requirements, a multi-degree-of-freedom and double screen bracket structure was selected. To simulate the motion and analyze the rigidity of the rack, after modelling with solidwork, ADAMS was used in motion simulation and ANSYS was used in fulfilling the stress analysis. Finally, the prototype was set up to verify the design, the intelligent display rack can arrange two screens in different ways to meet the typical needs, it can adjust smoothly and meet the rigid requirements. In this paper, a kind of intelligent rotatable display rack with two screens and multiple degrees of freedom was designed, which can automatically adjust the position of the display. The design improved the work efficiency and relieved the physical discomfort caused by using the display for a long time.

articleTitle: A Whale Optimization Algorithm of Assembly Planning in Pulsating Production
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to improve the assembly efficiency of pulsating production lines, the whale optimization algorithm is improved to settle the assembly sequence planning problem under pulsating production line mode. Construct a fitness function that includes four evaluation indicators: geometric feasibility, assembly stability, assembly aggregation, and assembly site feasibility, and solve it with the goal of having the lowest fitness. Add Tent chaotic mapping, Cauchy mutation, and adaptive weight parameters to the whale optimization algorithm to enhance global search ability and prevent it from falling into local optima. Select the vise as an example to verify the feasibility of the improved algorithm for solving the assembly sequence planning problem, and obtain the feasible assembly sequence with the lowest fitness.

articleTitle: Learning to Predict Tendency of CVE Vulnerability
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Predicting the trend of software vulnerabilities enables proactive warnings, aiding in mitigating security incident losses. Capturing the long-term dependencies among data is crucial for achieving highly accurate predictions. Leveraging the remarkable data relationship-capturing capabilities of learning-based methods demonstrated in various domains, we implemented several learning-based approaches to forecast the outbreak trend of software vulnerabilities. The results show that Informer, Autoformer, and DLinear achieved accuracy rates exceeding 90%. Informer, with its residual connection module, obtained significant prediction results with fewer data points. Autoformer, benefiting from its data decomposition structure, performed better in datasets with periodic patterns. DLinear, on the other hand, exhibited superior performance in relatively stable datasets. However, LSTM performed poorly across multiple datasets due to the cumulative error effect.

articleTitle: A Study of Task Offloading Strategies in IoV
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In this paper, we study task offloading for mobile edge computing in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV). We use response time as a system performance metric and use a closed queuing network to analyze the optimal task offloading probability, which enables task offloading to have latency fairness.When a vehicle offloads a task, there is an optimal offload probability allocation ratio so that the task has the same response time regardless of whether the task is offloaded to the cloud center or the edge layers to achieve task offload fairness. The distribution ratio to achieve fairness in task offloading is affected by the number of vehicles. Through experiments, we learn that the more vehicles there are, the more computational tasks need to be offloaded to the cloud server to achieve fairness. Also, the average response time of the edge server grows rapidly as the number of vehicles increases.

articleTitle: Optimization of SVM Based on IPSO Algorithm for Tool Life Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: As the basic parts of workshop processing, the life of the tool will affect the processing efficiency and processing quality, and the life of the tool will be affected by a variety of uncertain factors in the processing process, which makes it difficult to accurately predict. In order to improve the prediction accuracy, an improved IPSO algorithm was proposed to optimize the penalty factor c and kernel parameter g of SVM based on particle swarm optimization (PSO). Firstly, the influencing parameters of tool life are analyzed and the experimental data are extracted, and then the data is brought into the IPSO-SVM model to obtain the predicted data. IPSO algorithm can realize the adaptive change of inertia weight and introduce asynchronous learning formula to dynamically adjust the learning factor, which can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of tool life. Compared with the traditional PSO-SVM prediction model, the average relative error and average absolute error of IPSO-SVM are reduced by 5.275% and 5.006% respectively, which indicates that the SVM model optimized by IPSO algorithm has higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Robustness Analysis for Electric Vehicle Based on Uncertainty from Power Battery Packs
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: For the electric vehicle design, it is rare to consider the impact of the manufacturing and assembly errors of parts and other uncertain factors on the vehicle dynamic performance. The uncertainty of the power battery packs is studied in robust design of electric vehicles. Firstly, a virtual prototype model of an electric vehicle is built based on a multi-body dynamic modelling software of ADAMS including the parametric power battery packs. Secondly, the impact of the length, width and height size of power battery packs and the installation positioning of the power battery packs, such as the lateral, longitudinal and vertical installation positioning are all analyzed considering the vehicle roll angle. Finally, the robustness of the results from the different design method is compared applying the Monte Carlo method. The results show that the design method used in electric vehicle based on robust theory can effectively resist the interference of uncertain factors from power battery packs and improve the robustness of dynamic performance of electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Model Design and Research of Power Communication Equipment Evaluation Based on AI
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Power communication equipment is a fundamental element of the power system, and the safe and economic operation of the power grid depends on its normal operating condition. It is of great significance to study the power equipment assessment method based on artificial intelligence algorithms for comprehensively, timely and accurately grasping the operation status of power equipment and its development trend. The system studied in this paper is mainly implemented by embedded system, and the operation and test are realized through system construction, including real-time monitoring, data statistics and alarm analysis. The results can be directly applied to the communication operation and maintenance of all units in the system, which is innovative and can easily complete the transformation of intellectual property rights into products.

articleTitle: Target Localization of Short Vertical Line Array Based on Least Squares Method
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the shallow sea environment, array of small array elements may not be able to accurately locate targets due to undersampling. To address this issue, the paper proposed a method called sound field extension based on the reception of array of small array elements, which generates a virtual measurement field of a vertical array with lager number. The method utilizes the extended acoustic field for VTRM. This approach significantly improves the focusing and positioning performance of the TRM. The key implementation lies in estimating the normal wave mode coefficients from the acoustic field acquired by the short vertical line array. The paper uses the least squares method to estimate the mode coefficients. Experimental results demonstrate that compared to conventional time processing methods for an array of small array elements, the VTRM method using the a vertical array with a large number of elements can effectively enhance targeting and focusing performance of the short array. For array of small array elements with 21 elements, the SNR (Signal Interference to Noise Ratio) effectively improves by 4.32 dB.

articleTitle: Optimal Design and Research on Performance Parameters of Double Scissor Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: A lifting design scheme has been proposed for the simple three-dimensional garage in the paper, that is, the hydraulic mechanism of scissor-fork is used for lifting. Due to fork scissors mechanism parameters and oil cylinder position parameters influence the performance of organization, thus established the hydraulic oil cylinder thrust function for optimizing target, the mathematical model based on objective optimization theory, parameters optimization design by using MATLAB optimization toolbox, through comparative analysis of before and after the optimization parameters, obtained the reasonable structure parameters, After optimization, the thrust of the cylinder is reduced by 50.8%, which has important reference value for the construction of stereo garage and lifting technology.

articleTitle: Sensing Image Super-resolution Reconstruction Based on the UNet Decoding Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To enhance the super-resolution reconstruction quality of remote sensing images, this paper fully consider the multi-scale nature of internal features and proposes a multi-scale multi-level fusion network. This network is based on the UNet encoding and decoding network, introducing multi-scale feature extraction branches to further obtain rich scale features. Simultaneously focusing on features at all levels, a fusion module is proposed using the global attention mechanism (GAM) to improve the model's feature extraction ability. The image reconstruction task is completed using sub-pixel convolution. In this paper, the UC Merced dataset is selected and reconstructed with 2x, 3x and 4x reconstruction, in which the peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) values are 34.07 dB, 29.65 dB, and 27.63 dB, respectively, which are improved compared with some algorithms. These results further demonstrate the network presented in this paper is helpful in increasing the reconstruction quality of remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Research on Sentiment Analysis Fusion Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the aim of overcoming the limitations in feature extraction capability, OOV (out-of-vacabulary) and polysemous word in Chinese text sentiment analysis, dual attention gated recurrent neural network (AW-Att-BiGRU) with word and character information fusion was proposed. Firstly, character and word level vector are taken as input to the model to obtain semantic representation to the maximum extent. Then, characters and words with obvious emotional characteristics are given higher weights through the attention mechanism, to achieve a more comprehensive understanding of the emotional tendencies within the text and enhance the accuracy of sentiment analysis. Based on the experimental results using the Tan Songbo Hotel review dataset, the proposed model achieved an accuracy rate of 94.56%, and the accuracy rate on Weibo review dataset is 93.87%, which improves the performance compared with a single model and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Route Planning Based on Global Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the development of UAV technology, the route planning, obstacle avoidance and optimal flight path selection of UAV in the course of flight have become crucial. Ant colony algorithm, as an intelligent optimization algorithm, has a very powerful search ability and has been widely used in the field of route optimization. However, ant colony algorithm has some problems, such as slow convergence speed, local optimization and contradiction between population diversity and convergence speed. In this paper, the global improved ant colony algorithm is studied from the aspects of space modeling, obstacle shielding, guided path, adaptive random step algorithm, pheromone update and optimized route. From the three aspects of theoretical introduction, simulation experiment and experimental comparison, it is concluded that the improved ant colony algorithm has been significantly improved in terms of search performance and search efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Video Tracking Algorithm Based on Yolo Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the development of computer vision technology, target tracking is extensively used in traffic intelligence, security and many other realms. Deep learning is considered as an important supporting technology in the realms of video object tracking because of its excellent object modeling ability. The real-time target detection algorithm YOLOv3 has fast detection speed and good accuracy, but it has some defects, such as inaccurate boundary frame positioning and poor performance of multi-target tracking at high frame rates. In this paper, we propose a multi-target tracking algorithm based on YOLOv4 and SORT algorithm, which is based on deep learning neural network frame. First, YOLOv4 is used for target detection, and the detected pedestrian data is passed to SORT algorithm to realize multi-target tracking, and good performance can be achieved at high frame rate. By comparison, it can be concluded that the proposed multi-target tracking algorithm can improve the corresponding mAP value by about 6% and FPS value by 5s.

articleTitle: Research on Target Recognition and Tracking Technology Based on Laser Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In view of the common road surface, multiple objects in a complex environment, because the detection results of multiple objects are not ideal, resulting in errors in the detection results, in order to achieve the accurate tracking of the target object. The basic principle of Camshift algorithm is emphasized, and Kalman filtering algorithm is added in the tracking process to process the obtained target data to form a moving track, predict the position of the target next time, and solve the problem of follow-up tracking. Through the verification under the complex background of the daily road, it is found that the improved algorithm can effectively and accurately extract the moving target to be tracked from the continuous frames of the point cloud image, and has high robustness. The problem of high real-time requirement for target tracking has been effectively solved. The example shows that the prediction effect is good, and it is feasible.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Lane Change Status for Intelligent Vehicle Based on Fuzzy Bayesian
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: A multi-factor fusion risk assessment approach for lane shifting state is designed with the goal of increasing the safety of lane changing in the human-machine co-driving environment of intelligent vehicles. To begin, the urban road traffic risk factors are described at three levels: "human, vehicle, and road" to create the driving risk factor set; then, the key indicators are screened using principal component analysis; and finally, the vehicle lane change risk level is identified by combining fuzzy theory and Bayesian Network. The experimental and computational results show that the fuzzy Bayesian network model accurately reflects the impact of several factors on driving safety, with weather and acceleration having the most influence. Simultaneously, when compared to the traditional Bayesian network, this method can effectively compensate for the Bayesian network's inference precision shortcomings, accurately determine the degree of danger of lane-changing behavior, and determine the current driver's risk level as a potential risk (level IV), which provides a theoretical basis for when to make a safe switch of the driving right in the intelligent vehicle human-computer co-pilot system and how to select the lane-changing strategy.

articleTitle: Equipment System Optimization Method Based on Cost-efficiency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The current study of the effectiveness and cost of the equipment system does not involve the analysis from inception to formation and the optimization of the existing equipment system. This paper presents an optimization method of equipment system, which is based on cost-effectiveness analysis. First of all, the components of the equipment system to be studied or formed are defined, the number of factors affecting cost and effectiveness is determined, and the research methods and data processing methods for each factor are determined. Second, if the number of cost influencing factors exceeds the defined value, the influencing factors should be screened. The important influencing factors were obtained by sensitivity analysis. Thirdly, the final cost factor data and efficiency factor data are processed by summation polymerization method to get the final cost and efficiency overall evaluation results. Finally, the cost-effectiveness criterion is selected, the cost-effectiveness ratio is calculated, the cost-effectiveness ratio analysis results are evaluated, and the equipment system is perfected and optimized. This method can understand the optimization method of the equipment system in a more comprehensive way, with integrity, structure and enough flexibility.

articleTitle: Research on Dual Channel Medical Short Text Intention Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Common medical short text intention recognition When extracting local information, Convolutional neural network is better than other neural networks, but Convolutional neural network can't consider the whole situation of short text. To utilize whole sentence information, we propose a dual channel short text intention recognition model combining TextCNN and BiGRU-Att, which uses local features and global features to recognize short text intention, Optimized the use of intent recognition models for global text features. The AB-CNN-BGRU-att algorithm first utilizes the ALBERT multi-layer bidirectional Transformer structure to vectorize the input text, and then sends the vectors into the TextCNN and BiGRU network models to obtain local and global features. Fuse these two features and obtain the intention through softmax. The experimental data shows that in THUCNews_Title dataset, the AB-CNN-BGRU-att algorithm proposed in this article achieved an Acc of 96.68%, an F1 value of 96.67%, and an accuracy of 86.02% on the KUAKE-QIC dataset. Compared to other intention recognition models, the performance has been improved.

articleTitle: MA-Unet3+ Segmentation Network of Remote Sensing Image Based on ECA Block
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Semantic segmentation is a basal task and is a typical computer vision problem. Although semantic segmentation is developing rapidly, the speed and accuracy of model segmentation still need to be further improved. For solve the issue of scale differences between target objects and loss of spatial information in the segmentation task of remote sensing images, by improving the original U-Net3+ network and introducing the attention mechanism, a new network MA-Unet3+ is constructed. In the coding phase, images of unlike scales are fused, and the full-scale connections are pruned, some skip connections are removed, and attention mechanisms are introduced between each layer. The improved model is contrast with some common network models, and the experiment achieves 78.7% average intersection (mIoU) on the Vaihingen dataset, which is 0.8% better than this optimized network U-Net3+, the average category pixel accuracy (MPA) is 92.4%, which is 1.2% better, and the similarity coefficient (Dice) result is 87.3%, which is 0.8% better. 0.8%, it is observed that MA-Unet3+ is precede other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Image Defogging Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Image degradation due to fog and haze is a common problem in the field of life and image research. This article will be designed and implemented of image haze removal algorithm. The traditional methods have some problems such as low brightness, artifact, halo and distortion, but the existing methods based on deep learning have better effect. In this paper, we will propose a de-fogging network model, which is based on adversarial network. The generator in adversarial network is a convolutional neural network with residual network, which reduces the model training parameters and improves the parameter utilization. The discriminator uses the full convolutional network as the discriminator, which enhances the spatial sensitivity of the model to the image. In order to improve efficiency, the discriminator is simplified on the original structure. The loss function of the model is improved so that the model can get better training effect.

articleTitle: Reliability Prediction Based on SVR and Improved SCSO
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Reliability prediction can provide basis for the identification of potential improvement area, cost control, and mission reliability assessment, etc. However, for complex equipment, there are many reliability influencing factors and incomplete knowledge of failure causes, which lead to a significant disparity between the predicted outcomes and the real values for traditional reliability prediction methods. To address the above issues, this research paper introduces an approach that utilizes the Support Vector Regression (SVR) model and Sand Cat Swarm Optimization (SCSO). To begin with, the sliding window technique is employed on the historical reliability data to generate time series samples, with the 5 adjacent data as sample data, and the sixth as label of the sample, and train SVR model on these samples; Second, the SVR model parameters are optimized using the ISCSO algorithm to obtain the optimal combination of parameters. In the testing stage, firstly, historical reliability data was used to predicted future data by the model, and the predicted data are then added to the sequence to form new samples, thus old data are discarded and new data are predicted continuously to realize continuous reliability prediction. Finally, the algorithm proposed in this paper is validated on a diesel engine reliability dataset. The algorithm proposed in this paper demonstrates its superiority through the Normalized Root Mean Squared Error (NRMSE) evaluation. The NRMSE of SVR-ISCSO is 8.86E-05, showcasing a remarkable 99.24% year-on-year decrease compared to the standard SVR. Additionally, it exhibits a 5.86% year-on-year decrease compared to SVR-SCSO, further validating the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Property Personnel Management System Based on BLE Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Conduct research on the allocation of cleaning personnel and security personnel in property management, and based on in-depth research on the work standards of property cleaning personnel and security personnel, an intelligent management and control system is developed, comprehensively with applying technologies such as the Internet of Things, data communication, and big data analysis, for property personnel based on Bluetooth Low Energy technology for mobile positioning. This system is an Internet of Things application system that integrates hardware, software, and network. It can achieve comprehensive and timely control of the task completion of property cleaning personnel, the completion of patrol inspections by security personnel, and their movement trajectory information, so that the safety, work quality, progress, and hygiene of property communities are always under control, and achieve intensive, flat, and standardized property management, Comprehensively improve the level of safety management and control, sanitation and cleaning in property communities, and the level of property will be comprehensively enhanced.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration Monitoring System for Large Vibrating Screens
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This paper introduces an intelligent monitoring system aimed to minimize faults in industrial production for large vibrating screens. The system adopts high-sensitivity trivial acceleration sensors to capture complex raw vibration signals, which are analyzed to obtain vibration modes, allowing real-time online monitoring of the screen's condition. The research results indicate that the system can gather vibration parameters such as amplitude, frequency and direction angle at six testing points across three axes, and deliver prompt responses for swift fault identification, thereby reducing production expenses. The study contributes to the development of sophisticated monitoring techniques and precise control strategies for large vibrating screens, which can improve equipment service life and production efficiency.

articleTitle: Parameters Optimization of ADRC Based on DBO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) aims to achieve robust and effective control performance in the presence of uncertainty, interference, and nonlinearity. However, the parameters of ADRC are numerous and difficult to adjust. To solve this problem, an ADRC parameter tuning method based on the DBO was proposed in this article. By defining the parameters of ADRC that need to be tuned as a vector, the DBO algorithm automatically finds the optimal parameters through iterative optimization. Taking a typical second-order system PMSM as an example, the process of optimizing ADRC parameters using DBO is presented by defining fitness function. The DBO-ADRC strategy was compared with traditional ADRC and PID controllers. The simulation results indicate that DBO-ADRC obtains no overshoot and shorter setting time. Therefore, this method effectively improves the control performance of ADRC.

articleTitle: Automated Channel Pruning Strategy Based on Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Model compression is an effective method for compressing neural networks, where channel pruning plays an important role. The traditional channel pruning is a method that picks and chooses channels by judging the importance of weights and the experience of manual pruning, which has certain human interference factors and is prone to produce suboptimal network structures. To this end, an automated dynamic channel pruning method based on an artificial bee colony algorithm, called DPruner, is proposed, which focuses on finding the best pruning structure in the network model by a manual bee colony algorithm and then pruning the network model. In order to solve the complexity of network structure combinations, this paper first reduces the range of initialized pruning structure combinations, and finally filters the best pruning structure combinations by updating the initialized pruning structure combinations. The method avoids the interference of human factors, and the effectiveness of the method was verified in the experiment.

articleTitle: Wavefront Reconstruction Method Based on Improved U-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Laser transmission in the atmosphere is subject to atmospheric turbulence effects that cause wavefront aberrations, resulting in a degradation of beam quality and difficulty in obtaining information. In order to correct the wavefront aberration, it is extremely important to accurately obtain the phase information of beam aberration wavefront for adaptive optics and laser atmospheric transmission system. In this paper, a wavefront reconstruction model based on improved U-Net is established to directly reconstruct the aberrated wavefront by training the aberrated wavefront and the far-field focal plane and out-of-focus plane images, and at the same time, in order to study the relationship between the reconstructed wavefront accuracy and the number of Zernike terms used, the reconstructed wavefronts are represented by the first 50, first 120, first 200, and first 500 Zernike polynomials, respectively. The experimental outcomes illustrate that the wavefront reconstruction precision of the improved U-Net is higher, and the more Zernike polynomial terms used in the reconstructed wavefront, the smaller the coefficient error and the higher the recovered wavefront accuracy. The method can provide strong support for the subsequent wavefront aberration correction, and has certain application value in the fields of turbulence compensation, atmospheric turbulence characterization and adaptive optics.

articleTitle: Research on Super-resolution Image Processing Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: When the existing super-resolution model preprocesses low-resolution images, the efficiency of the feature extraction module is low and the details cannot be accurately captured. In this paper, SRGAN is selected as the basic method of the topic, and it is used as a reference to obtain the existing lightweight multilevel generated Adversarial network. In this paper, SRGAN is selected as the basic method of the topic, and it is used as a reference to obtain the existing lightweight multilevel generated aversion network. The network model of this method adopts the core idea of generating antagonistic network, and makes progress from the mutual game between two network modules to achieve better results. By taking advantage of the advantages of SRGAN network, the residual channel block and skip connection are mainly added to overcome the low operating efficiency of SRGAN network, and the PNSR improves by 1.01 and SSIM improves by 0.053. It is also more stable during the operation of image super resolution.

articleTitle: Small Target Detection Optimization Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The accuracy of the traditional model algorithms mainly oriented to detection of small target is generally low, the unstable problem, we have made modifications on the basis of YOLOv5 and proposed a more suitable algorithm for detecting small targets. First of all, increased the effective channel attention mechanism, solves the convolution the characteristics of the loss, as a result of the global context information loss in the process of problem, improves the fuzzy image cases of small target detection accuracy. Secondly, the network structure is reconstructed, the multi-scale network model is established, and the target detection layer is combined to improve the detection performance of remote sensing small target model at different scales under the feature information extraction network. Finally, by integrating the loss function SIOU into the whole model, the improved algorithm has made progress in many aspects. The improved algorithm is compared with the original YOLOv5 model. The data obtained from the experiment mean that on the VOC data sets, the accuracy value of ours is higher than original algorithm 0.7%, 0.8% percentage points higher than YOLOv5s small target detection accuracy.

articleTitle: A Study of Multimodal Identification Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate unimodal determination and decision layer fusion methods in multimodal face recognition and to evaluate the effectiveness of decision layer fusion. Experiments are conducted on the "VidTIMIT" and "MOBIO" datasets using convolutional neural networks and MFCC feature extraction techniques. The performance of three feature fusion methods, front-end fusion, intermediate fusion and decision layer fusion, is compared. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracies are 94.9%, 94.7% and 94%, 94.1% for the face and voice models only, respectively. However, the accuracy decreases slightly in the case of front-end fusion. The best accuracy was achieved when the decision layer fusion method was used, reaching 95.7% and 95.6%, respectively. This indicates that training face and voice print data separately and fusing classifier output scores can effectively improve face recognition accuracy. This study explores feature fusion methods in the field of multimodal face recognition and experimentally demonstrates the advantages of decision layer fusion in improving accuracy, pointing to a new direction for future research.

articleTitle: The Application and Impact of Artificial Intelligence Technology in International Trade
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence technology is having a major impact on the global economy, and its application is also subtly changing the way of global international trade. Digital technologies will have a profound impact on global economic trade, estimated to increase global trade by about 2% per year until 2030.While accelerating the process of a new round of industrial revolution, artificial intelligence will trigger the return of manufacturing, and then have an important impact on the world trade pattern industry, has become a hot issue worthy of attention at present. Think globally, Based on the analysis of panel data in China and some OECD countries, it is found that artificial intelligence has a significant positive impact on import and export trade. By studying the impact of the development of artificial intelligence on international trade, and putting forward effective suggestions for it, we can guide the development of China's international trade work.

articleTitle: Research on the Practice of Green Supply Chain Management of Foreign Trade Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the increasingly fierce economic globalization and market competition, the supply chain as the third source of profit has received great attention from enterprise operators, and its significance to foreign trade enterprises is more prominent. At present, foreign trade enterprises not only emphasize high efficiency in supply chain management, but also pay more attention to green management, social responsibility, national strategy and other topics. This paper will take Delphi Automotive Systems (China) Investment Co., Ltd., which receives an average of 320 million parts and raw materials from all over the world every day, and purchases more than 10 billion US dollars annually as an example to study the challenges of green supply chain management in the practice of international trade enterprises in China and the latest progress in the generation of green supply chain, and discuss the problems and development trends of green supply chain management in the practice of Chinese enterprises.

articleTitle: DV-Hop Localization Strategy Based on Beacon Node Confidence Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To address the problem that the DV-Hop localization model for wireless sensor networks can no longer meet the current localization accuracy requirements, this paper proposes the concept of beacon node trustworthiness to provide ideas and basis for improving the optimization model. Based on the principle of least squares in the localization model, weighted least squares is introduced to present the trustworthiness for beacon nodes with different characteristics. To analyze the characteristics of the trustworthiness of beacon nodes, 18 functions are designed in terms of function instrumentality and decrement able, hierarchical faultiness, etc. Finally, the conclusions obtained from the credibility test are tested with weighted matrix and average hop distance weighting, and the localization error is reduced from 32.68% to 31.78%, with a role rate of 100%. The credibility characteristics of beacon nodes discussed in this paper provide ideas for subsequent optimization of the localization model.

articleTitle: Target RCS Prediction Based on Residual Structure and Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The existing network structures used for radar cross-sectional area (RCS) prediction include mainstream network structures such as BPNN and LSTM neural network. These networks are capable of learning the RCS characteristics of objects and making predictions on the RCS of objects. However, due to the limited RCS data features, increasing the network depth to learn more features may result in model degradation. Therefore, this paper proposes adding a residual connection module to the BPNN to address the issue of network degradation. Moreover, in practical applications, obtaining RCS data is challenging, and the available data is limited. Training the network solely on existing data can lead to poor robustness and overfitting. To tackle this problem, this paper improves the dataset by augmenting the original data with multiple sets of Gaussian noise data for data augmentation. When using the BP neural network for prediction, the mean absolute error (MAE) is 2.84. After incorporating the residual connection module, the MAE predicted by the model decreases to 2.21. Furthermore, after data enhancement based on the network structure, the model achieves a further decrease in MAE to 1.83. Experimental results demonstrate that the BPNN augmented with deep residual connections improves the prediction accuracy of the target RCS. Additionally, the application of Gaussian data augmentation further enhances the accuracy of the RCS prediction model.

articleTitle: A Framework for Endoscopic Image Classification Enhanced by Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a framework for endoscopic image classification based on deep transfer learning (TL), specifically designed to address the unique challenges of endoscopic medical image classification. Our approach focuses on the performance of a convolutional neural network (CNN) model based on the ResNet architecture. To further improve the model's prediction accuracy and robustness, we introduce two ResNet variants: ResNe-SE and ResNet-CBAM, which incorporate the Squeeze-Excitation Module and Convolutional Block Attention Module, respectively. These modules allow the model to selectively learn significant features while suppressing noisy and unimportant features by capturing the dependencies between channels and spatial locations, ultimately achieving optimal performance compared to numerous baseline models. Furthermore, since limited training data can lead to overfitting of deep learning models, we apply deep TL to the field of medical image classification by fine-tuning parameters during model training based on models pre-trained on the publicly available ImageNet dataset. This approach addresses the problem of a limited number of endoscopic images. The results of our ablation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of using deep TL techniques for this task, the improvements are 22.8%, 25.9%, and 13.3% for VGG-16, ResNet-34, and ResNet-50, respectively.

articleTitle: A Spatial-temporal Detecting Method for Low-altitude Slow and Small Target
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: UAV, as a rapidly developing and applied aircraft, poses a great threat to low altitude safety while bringing various changes. The complexity of low altitude environments and the small size, low speed, and flexibility of UAVs pose significant challenges to the detection of low altitude UAVs. Visual methods have the characteristics of real-time and flexibility, making them suitable for fast detection in close range. But the problems of detecting features of UAV from low contrast and low-resolution images by applying vision method are needed to be solved. A detecting method which combines morphology filtering in spatial domain and correlation in temporal domain is presented in this paper. The contrast of images is enhanced by extract background of images using morphology filtering. This improves the efficiency and reliability of detection. Because positions of object in the images are continuous, the incorrect results are rectified by calculating the correlation of positions in temporal domain. The theoretical analysis and experiment show that this method can detect the UAV successfully from low contrast images and is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Multilevel Degradater Model under Unsupervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In most super-resolution experiments, because the data set in the real scene cannot meet the quantity requirements, it is necessary to downsample the high-resolution images using the degradation method to obtain the same proportion of low-resolution images. However, because the same degradation method is used to process images, the processing process of low-resolution images is relatively simple, which is easy to cause model solidification in the subsequent training process. After the training is completed, the generalization ability will be generally low due to the single underlying degradation method. This paper uses the SRMD method to build an unsupervised multilevel degradation, and takes advantage of the adduction network generated in unsupervised learning. After extracting image features, it adopts anisotropic Gaussian fuzzy kernel, bi-cubic subsampling and additive Gaussian noise to compose the degradation training data set. Compared with the traditional bi-cubic PNSR, the performance is improved by 5%. The SSIM value is increased by 3%, and the running speed is increased by 7% on average.

articleTitle: Research of the Development of Riveting Technology and Riveting Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Using the wave of intelligent manufacturing, this article mainly introduces several riveting processes on the packaging manufacturing line and some rivet mechanisms with semi -automated characteristics. According to the research status of the development of its technology at home and abroad and the phased results obtained, explore the lack of the synergies and automation of the components and automation of the packaging production line, and propose a solution to optimize the riveting process and improve the process. The application and high-quality development of intelligent manufacturing provides some reference.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Identification and Evaluation of Gree Product R&D in Manufacturing Industry Based on R-AHP
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This paper first analyzes the current state and characteristics of green product R&D in manufacturing industry, then uses surveys, interviews and other methods to determine the preliminary important risk factors. After the Delphi method is used to determine the risk evaluation index, R-AHP method is used to construct the risk index system of green product R&D and calculate the weight. Finally, based on the findings, the risk response scheme and safeguard measures are proposed, which has certain reference value for green product R&D projects in the manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Event Extraction Method with No-trigger
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Event extraction is a key task in the field of natural language processing, which aims to structure text in preparation for tasks such as subsequent knowledge graph construction. Most of the existing event extraction methods are difficult to handle well the case of containing multiple events within the same document and to distinguish efficiently for negative obfuscation samples. In this paper, we propose a model called RCEENT (A RoBERTa-wwm-based Chinese Event Extraction method with No-Trigger). RCEENT based on RoBERTa-wwm encoder and PTPCG (Pseudo-Trigger-aware Pruned Complete Graph) decoder to address the above problems. The RCEENT model can improve the accuracy of the event detection module without adding too much complexity by using multiple binary classifiers, and improve the results of the event extraction task by using graph pruning and PTPCG model for decoding. RCEENT achieves a 1.4% F1 score improvement in the event detection task and a 3.9% F1 score improvement in the event extraction task on Duee-fin compared to the latest baseline method.

articleTitle: Joint Modeling of Multi-domain Digital Twins for Lithium Battery Pack
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Battery digital twins are on the revolutionary edge of battery management systems, but it is challenging to establish digital twins that accurately reflect each battery state in the physical pack, for the unique thermal field of every single cell caused by the variety of spatial distribution and battery pack's thermal dissipation conditions in different application scenarios. From the view of multi-domain, it is more approaching to the true state in physical space by jointing more digital twin in different physical domain, and this paper demonstrated the point by coupling battery pack in electric and thermal domain. The experiment verify the feasibility and validity of the proposed joint modeling method.

articleTitle: A Rolling Bearing Fault Prediction Model Based on LSSVM-HMM
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The working environment of self-propelled artillery is harsh, and there are many types of failures. Rolling bearings are important mechanical parts of self-propelled artillery, and their health is very important. Aiming at the problem that the traditional single state prediction method is difficult to accurately predict the rolling bearing fault, this paper proposes a fault prediction model LSSVM-HMM which combines the Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) and the Hidden Markov Model (HMM). The LSSVM-HMM fault prediction model fully combines the nonlinear prediction ability of LSSVM and the decoding ability of HMM. First, the historical operating state data of rolling bearings is obtained to train LSSVM, and the current state data is input into the trained LSSVM model to predict rolling bearings in the future. Then, the HMM model under different fault states is trained through the historical operating state data of the bearing; finally, the current state data and the prediction data obtained by the LSSVM model are input into the trained HMM model to predict the state of the rolling bearing in the future. The CWRU public bearing data set is used for verification. The experimental results show that the accuracy of fault prediction for rolling bearings through the LSSVM-HMM prediction model can reach 94.62%, which can effectively predict the state of rolling bearings.

articleTitle: A Flexible Calibration Method for Fringe Projection Profilometry
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The fringe projection profilometry (FPP) is an optical method which reconstruction 3D object by using structured light. The Calibration is inevitable in FPP. The calibration procedure is to establish a connection between height and light field information. The existing calibration methods usually need precise z stages and/or interpolation on markers and are complex and time-cost. We present a flexible calibration algorithm for fringe projection profilometry. It avoids these by using ray-phase model and designing a two-step calibration procedure. The ray-phase equations formulate the relation of 3D coordinates and phase. During the calibration procedure, an auxiliary camera is introduced to construct a stereo vision system with measurement system. Firstly, the stereo vision system is calibrated by using traditional method. Then the coordinates and absolute phases, which are both obtained by measuring the calibration object with the stereo vision system, are applied to fit ray-phase equations. Both theoretical analysis and experimental results are provided. In the experiment, standard deviation of the plane is 0.0422 mm. They show that our calibration algorithm is flexible, feasible and accurate.

articleTitle: Prediction of Protein Secondary Structure Based on Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The secondary structure prediction of proteins is an important subject in bioinformatics. However, the huge model and low sequence homology hinder rational prediction. Herein, we propose a new approach that uses the deep metric learning based on a lightweight convolutional network to predict the secondary structure of protein. Firstly, the database BDF was used to train the ProtT5 language model and transfer the output features to our model as input. Then, we construct a lightweight convolutional network with a multi-branch network, channel attention, and introduce a mask matrix to ensure that the filling position does not affect the subsequent feature extraction. Compared with the other six methods, this method has better prediction performance on four data sets: CASP12, CASP13, CASP14 and CB513.

articleTitle: A New Approach for Iris Segmentation Based on U-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The concept of iris segmentation was created to increase the accuracy of iris recognition. Past recognition methods used the entire eye image directly for recognition classification, which led to poor recognition results. For the sake of sovling this problem, this paper proposes the ResU-Net (RU-Net) model, which can guide the network to learn more features that distinguish between iris and non-iris pixels. First, based on the U-Net, the backbone network model is changed to ResNet50 in this paper. This has the advantage of reducing the number of parameters and network complexity, and improving the learning capability. For the sake of solving the problem of sample imbalance between iris region and background region, this paper introduces the Focal Loss loss function. focal loss can effectively deal with the case of sample category imbalance and make the network focus more on the pixels that are difficult to classify. In this paper, the proposed RU-Net model is experimentally evaluated on the CASIA-Iris-Thousand dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that RU-Net achieves significant improvements on NIR iris images, reaching 96.22% MIoU and 98.19% MPA. This indicates that the RU-Net method outperforms other representative iris segmentation methods and has better segmentation capability.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning of Aerial Combat Maneuver Decisions Based on UAVs Situation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Traditional UAV air warfare decision methods lack innovative maneuvering behavior. In this paper, we proposed an autonomous decision-making for UAVs based on deep reinforcement learning to solve the maneuvering decision-making problem in air warfare. Firstly, the air combat situation can be effectively calculated via Bayesian inference theory. Then, the UAV state transfer equation is established based on the its three-degree-of-freedom model. Specifically, the aerial combat situation affects the distribution of rewards. And the rewards are comprehensively designed by angle, distance, speed, and altitude. Thus, with Bayesian inference, the situation is calculated for changing the weights of rewards. Besides, the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) random noise, is introduced to improve the algorithm's exploratory performance during the training process. The aerial combat simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, with the moving average reward values ultimately converging within the range of 120-130.

articleTitle: Research on Dim Target Detection Model Based on Eye Movement Data
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Dim targets detection under complex backgrounds is a classic problem in the field of automatic target recognition (ATR). The human visual attention mechanism can effectively avoid background clutter interference, which provides a new idea for solving this problem. Traditional visual attention models are limited in practice due to task definition, computational accuracy and other reasons. This work focuses on dim object detection and high-precision visual attention modeling by using deep neural network. Firstly, the head-eye movement measurement technology is used to conduct visual attention experiments and build a complete human visual dataset. And then, a visual attention calculation model with complete visual processing capabilities is conducted based on the generative adversarial network (GAN) framework. Finally, based on the attention model, a new algorithm for small object detection driven by visual attention is proposed. This detection method can achieve a detection probability of 0.78 and a false alarm rate of 0.19×10-4 on the test dataset, which proves its effectiveness. Therefore, the research has reference significance for promoting the development of ATR-related technologies.

articleTitle: Multi-circular SAR Trajectory Design Based on Wavenumber Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Multi-circular SAR (MCSAR) maintains the transmitted signal beam still pointing to the same observing scene, and the platform continually watches around the scene many times in a general way, which can achieve the three-dimensional characteristics of the target for all directions and is the hotspot for CSAR imaging research. A reasonable flight path is the prerequisite of MCSAR imaging. In this article, the wavenumber spectrum and support domain of the MCSAR is derived from the echo signal model of the frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) system. The characteristics of the MCSAR wavenumber spectrum support domain with a fixed radius, variable radius, and spiral trajectory are compared and analyzed through simulation. The results show that under the same flight space conditions, the wavenumber spectrum support domain varies from different trajectories. MCSAR with flight radius decreasing to flight height is the optimum trajectory. The wavenumber spectrum support domain of spiral trajectory is coiled, which is not suitable for the CSAR trajectory. They provide a theoretical basis to design the MCSAR trajectory.

articleTitle: Poisson Noise Image Restoration Based on Bregman Proximal Gradient
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In view of the fact that data item functions are not smooth in Poisson noise image restoration, while most existing first-order optimization methods require data item smoothness, a Poisson noise image restoration method based on BPG (Bregman Proximal Gradient) algorithm was proposed. Firstly, we establish a Poisson noise image recovery model using the maximum posterior estimation framework. This model aims to recover a high-quality image from noisy input data corrupted by Poisson noise. The model's data term is determined by the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, which corresponds to the likelihood estimation. The KL divergence measures the difference between the probability distributions of the noisy input data and the recovered image. The regular term uses the Tikhonov regular term, which corresponds to a priori estimation. Secondly, the BPG algorithm is employed to address the model, which gives a wider and more satisfactory smoothness based on Bregman distance to replace the traditional gradient Lipschitz smoothness requirements, and maintains the convergence speed of PG (Proximal Gradient) algorithm. Finally, numerical experimental results, it proposed method outperforms the conventional algorithm by a margin of 0.01--6.94 (db) in terms of recovering Poisson noise images, and it also outperforms several algorithms in visual effects.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of UAVs Supertorsional Sliding Modules Based on Variable Load Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Unmanned logistics is leading the new trend in the development of the logistics industry. Drone delivery possesses the great economic potential for its merits of improving distribution efficiency, relieving traffic congestion, expanding coverage radius, and reducing carbon emissions, but the security of cargo drones is intensively affected by some load variations, which will lead to drone crashes and goods destruction. In this paper, an optimized continuous function is proposed to replace the most popular sign function within the sliding mode algorithm, which is integrated with a super-twist algorithm to reduce the attitude and position buffeting caused by cargo variation. The Z-axis fluctuation range of the drone-cargo joint model is reduced by 10% compared with the classical method in the simulation.

articleTitle: Application of Three-dimensional Reconstruction Based on Improved ICP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: When the depth camera is used to scan the scene in 3D reconstruction technology, there may be some problems such as incomplete model or low definition in the reconstruction process due to the fast movement of the camera or the lack of texture information of the scene. The main idea is to use inertial sensor IMU to improve the RGB-D camera positioning of 3D reconstruction, and to estimate the pose by using the displacement data collected by IMU and ICP algorithm. The main purpose is to ensure that the camera tracking is not lost in the absence of effective registration points in the image data, enhance the overall robustness of Kinect Fusion algorithm, and improve the accuracy of 3D reconstruction. The experimental results show that the algorithm can significantly improve the reconstruction accuracy of the regional phase solution method, and has good robustness, and has a good effect in the application of 3D reconstruction.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Iris Recognition Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Iris recognition algorithms are becoming more and more widely used in daily life, and the accuracy requirements for iris recognition algorithms are getting higher and higher. Therefore, in this paper, an improved Shufflenetv2 algorithm is proposed as a way to improve the speed and accuracy of current iris recognition algorithms in daily life. In this paper, deep and shallow features are filtered by using the channel attention mechanism, which enables the model to acquire feature representations of both underlying and high-level semantics. In addition, in the loss function, this paper uses the focal loss function instead of the cross entropy loss function to achieve a solution to the imbalance between the number of positive and negative samples and prevent too much learning to negative sample features. By validating on the CASIA-Iris-Thousand dataset, which is commonly used in iris recognition tasks, the proposed model achieves an equal error rate (EER) of 1.66% compared to the Shufflenetv2 model, which has an EER of 5.3%, and optimizes by 3.64%. The model proposed in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of iris recognition.

articleTitle: Based on Remote Fire Path Planning Method Under the Background of Joint Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: At present, the methods to realize real-time transmission of ground information and data by remote fire command center and to plan the artillery path with minimum cost have their own advantages. In order to improve the combat ability of far-fire strike and joint operation, a heuristic search algorithm of far-fire, A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> path planning algorithm, is proposed here. The Air Force acquired real-time geographic information and data of the combat area through remote sensing technology, and then rasterized the acquired real-time map and transmitted it to the ground remote fire command center. Firstly, the cost of each node is calculated by this function. Second, every point that can be reached after the function is evaluated, and then the search begins. When searching, always select the point around the current location with the lowest traffic cost to expand, and finally generate a path with the lowest traffic cost. This method can make full use of the advantages of joint operation and show excellent performance in solving the optimal path when the environment information is known.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Digital Surface Interface for Virtual Gear Measurement Center Based on VC++
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The virtual gear measurement center is a software system developed in imitation of the real gear measurement center. Currently, the sample work piece used is an STL solid, with low accuracy. This paper designs a digital surface loading interface for the virtual gear measurement center. By analyzing the IGES file structure and the format of the digital surface, a digital surface IGES reading method is designed. With the MFC of VC++6.0 as the platform, combined with OpenGL Graphics library, the digital surface is imported into the virtual gear measurement center, realizing the surface visualization, and completing the relevant adaptability functions. Multiple sets of surfaces were selected for testing, and the test results were provided to verify the universality of the interface and expand the variety of digital chemical components.

articleTitle: Research on Target Measurement Technology Based on Air-based Multi-UAV System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Studying the accuracy of air-based target measurement is crucial to meet the demand for high-precision positioning of space targets. In this paper, a space flight target measurement method based on air-based multi-unmanned aerial vehicle (multi-UAV) system is proposed by using air-based image marker UAVs and ground image markers as image control points, combined with multi-UAV system. Firstly, by establishing a model of object-image relationship based on the pixel coordinates and spatial coordinates of the image control points, the UAV's attitude angles are calculated through mathematical operations; Secondly, combining the target's position information in the picture and the UAV's attitude information, calculating the azimuth and pitch angles of the target. Finally, by applying the principle of anisotropic rendezvous and combining the relationship between the measurement errors of each site, the angular measurement data from multi-UAV are weighted and fused based on the measurement errors, so as to obtain the target's motion trajectory. The experimental results show that the air-based measurement system in this paper can measure the trajectory of the space flight target with an accuracy of up to 14.9858m, which meets the requirements of subsequent data processing.

articleTitle: Autonomous Path Planning of AGV Obstacle Avoidance Based on Improved Q-learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: "Industry 4.0" and" Made in China 2025" have promoted the development of industrial automation equipment industry, and AGVs play a key role in warehousing intelligence and transportation efficiency. Research on AGV path planning is of great significance and application value for efficient, safe and high-quality path planning. Aiming at the problem of material transportation path planning in H company's static workshop, this paper proposes a path obstacle avoidance planning method based on improved Q learning algorithm. By optimizing Q learning parameters and introducing B-spline curve fitting technology to improve the algorithm, the AGV path is planned more effectively, and the operation efficiency and stability are improved. Through the analysis of simulation model verification results, the path length is 20.8995 meters before path smoothing and 21.2756 meters after path smoothing, with a small increase and little impact on work efficiency. Path smoothing reduces turning points and turning points, avoids path overlap and misalignment, and improves path efficiency. After the path smoothing improvement, the travel time was reduced from 15.8465 minutes to 10.1471 minutes, which was significantly reduced. Improve warehouse management level and transportation efficiency, and contribute to the development of industrial automation equipment industry.

articleTitle: Braking Energy Recovery of Pure Electric Vehicles with Compound Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To increase the range of pure electric vehicles and improve safety and stability during a braking, a compound control strategy that combines a fuzzy control algorithm based on the I curve, ECE regulation (M curve), and f line group is proposed. Braking energy recovery is affected by a variety of factors, and this paper primarily selects three influencing factors in order to develop a schematic diagram of the recovery of energy control strategy.
