A fuzzy control strategy with three input parameters and one output parameter is created by design a fuzzy controller, which uses the braking force, battery SOC, and the required vehicle speed as the input amounts and the proportional coefficient K of the motor participating in the braking as an output amount. Under the NEDC cycle condition, the control strategy of the AVL_Cruise and MATLAB/Simulink is simultaneously simulated. The results showed that the effective recovery efficiency of energy has been increased by 3.824%.

articleTitle: Research on Super-twisting Sliding Mode Control Based on Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In this paper, a Super-twisting sliding mode control strategy on account of a nonlinear disturbance observer is proposed to solve the problem of disturbance suppression in the beam scanning process of MEMS micromirrors, in response to the degradation of the scanning precision of MEMS micromirrors due to external perturbation in the beam scanning process. The working mechanism of MEMS micromirror beam scanning is analyzed, the system model of MEMS micromirror is constructed, and the NDOB-Super-twisting controller is designed. The step response test, robustness test, and perturbation suppression analysis simulation are carried out. The results show that NDOB-Super-twisting controller has a 56.25% improvement in regulation time, no overshooting, and about 60% improvement in steady state error compared to the PID controller.

articleTitle: Autonomous Path Planning for Mobile Robots in Multi Obstacle Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The mobile robot will suffer from a lack of direction in the search, numerous redundant nodes, and a prolonged algorithm running time when there are more obstacles in the environment. As a result, the attraction force of the goal point to the robot and the repulsive force of the obstacle to the mobile robot are utilized in conjunction to identify the growth direction of the growing tree in this study, which is based on RRT and the operating principle of the artificial potential field technique. The simulation results indicate that in a multi obstacle environment, the enhanced RRT algorithm outperformed the conventional RRT algorithm in terms of autonomous path planning efficiency by 6.15 times, reduced the length of the planned path by 34.24 meters, and decreased the average number of iterations by 46.93%; And the upgraded RRT algorithm has 2.23 times the efficiency in autonomous path planning compared to the RRT* algorithm and 14.50% fewer iterations on average, but its projected ideal path is 0.61 meters longer. Therefore, the improved RRT algorithm has more directional search, more efficient planning efficiency, and relatively fewer average iterations when conducting path planning.

articleTitle: Research on Mental Robot Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Psychological counseling is one of the effective ways to solve psychological problems at present, and psychological counseling robot as a new interactive dialogue system tool (dialogue system refers to the system of dialogue with users through natural language processing) has significant research significance. In this paper, a psychological counseling robot based on natural language processing is developed by using Rasa framework and database Neo4j. The robot can assist users in psychological counseling, and help users better understand relevant knowledge by generating knowledge maps. Moreover, the psychological counseling robot has better semantic understanding ability and richer knowledge base. Aiming at the problem of low dialogue quality existing in functional components of Rasa framework, this paper analyzes the causes of this problem, and puts forward the corresponding algorithm model optimization and function improvement methods. In order to solve the problem of Chinese word recognition, the method based on rule template is used to improve the word recognition. In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of action prediction in dialogue management module, this system uses the cyclic neural network (RNN) model to improve the accuracy of action prediction. By constructing a sequence mapping model based on RNN, the original input was changed from sparse word vector to dense word vector, and experiments were designed to explore the key parameters affecting the experimental results, and then compared with the full-text retrieval model. Experimental results show that the answers generated by the model are about 10% more reasonable than those retrieved based on other similar models (e.g., Lucene).

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technology of Non-contact Vital Signs Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to rapidly build a real-time non-contact vital sign monitoring system, this study establishes a real-time non-contact heart rate, respiratory rate and oxygen saturation monitoring system based on a laptop camera. In the paper, the minimum hardware requirements are analyzed, three common face detection models are compared, the selection of ROI for each physiological parameter is determined, a suitable time window is selected, the physiological parameter solving method is clarified, and key technologies such as data stability are addressed. Through the analysis of the filtered real-time three-channel physiological parameters waveform, the filtered waveform is clear and smooth with good signal quality and obvious peaks in the frequency domain analysis graph. The average error of heart rate is 2 beats per minute, respiration rate is 4.6 beats per minute and blood oxygen is 5% in the quasi-static experimental environment, with good accuracy, which can provide a reference for building a real-time non-contact physiological parameters monitoring system.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm of Detecting Abnormal Data in Geological Disaster System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: A large amount of data is collected during geological hazard monitoring, which is extremely valuable for further data mining, hazard monitoring and decision analysis. However, in the process of data collection and transmission may be affected by interference and other factors, resulting in the generation of abnormal data. To extract higher value information from these basic data, it is necessary to improve the quality of source data first, so it is necessary to detect the abnormal data. The monitoring data of the geological disaster are time-series data, which have the characteristics of time-series correlation. The nearest neighbor difference jump anomaly detection algorithm is suitable for monitoring anomalous data of geological disaster system, but there are shortcomings in selecting floating values and correlation perception. To address these problems, the nearest neighbor difference jumping algorithm is improved and a algorithm is proposed to detect anomalous data of geological disasters, i.e., the data series are segmented by using sliding windows, the selection of floating values is improved, the calculation range of difference values is expanded to enhance the correlation of data, and the concept of change speed is incorporated to better perceive the trend of change before and after the data, and finally the anomaly is determined by using the anomaly probability and correlation. After the experimental comparison and analysis, the accuracy and recall rate of the proposed method on the detection of geological disaster data are improved and meet the expected results.

articleTitle: A Trade-off Method for a Joint Land Combat Equipment Scale System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Joint operations are the key to winning future wars, and although all countries are exploring ways of joint operations, there has been less research into the scale of equipment systems for combat. In this thesis, through the trade-off of the scale of the equipment system in joint land operations, the study of weapon system combination selection for large-scale complex systems based on intelligent algorithms. Firstly, we analyse from an algorithmic point of view and select the differential evolutionary algorithm as the main approach to solve the problem, complemented by the TOPSIS method to perform the weapon system allocation operation within the combination. A combination selection optimisation algorithm based on DE-TOPSIS is then developed, which provides a practical as well as effective approach to the trade-offs in the size system of land-based joint combat equipment.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Teaching Experiment Platform for Automobile Major
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Courses of automobile major are combined of automobiles, information control, software communication, etc. so it is difficult for teachers to teach these courses. And there is an important issue that if we can have some special experiment platforms and how to use them to combine theory and practice in teaching. This article is based on the characteristics of the course-"Intelligent Networked Cars", and we design a car teaching experimental platform based on perceptual applications. We use it in some typical teaching scenarios. By improving and optimizing the traditional algorithms, it can have a detection accuracy of over 3% higher than other algorithms for close range targets within 15 meters and demonstrate the analysis of the real environment. With this car teaching platform, the car model and algorithm system are combined to achieve testing experiments in real traffic scenarios. Students can get the real-time analysis and dynamic demonstration of course teaching, and it also improves students' learning efficiency. Besides that, we can share the theoretical and practical data by the experimental platform, and it is useful of the deep integration of major course teaching and research.

articleTitle: Laser Point Cloud Target Detection Based on Improved PointPillars
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Laser point cloud object detection plays a key role in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems, therefore, particularly important is the development of reliable algorithms for 3D object recognition. The accuracy of PointPillars algorithm in identifying small targets is low, this paper proposes an improved laser point cloud object detection method. Three key improvements were introduced based on PointPillars: Softplus activation function, attention mechanism SOPA (pillar second order of point attention) and increased positive sample weight. First, the activation function in PointPillars is replaced by Softplus. As a smooth nonlinear activation function, the Softplus function improves the detection ability of the target by enhancing the nonlinear modeling ability. Second, The attention mechanism SOPA is introduced, which improves the detection ability of important objects by adaptively weighting the key information in the point cloud. Finally, by increasing the weight of positive samples, the model places more emphasis on the accuracy of positive sample classification, which may improve the detection ability of positive samples. The extensive experimental evaluation of the improved PointPillars algorithms are conducted on the publicly available KITTI dataset. Compared with the traditional PointPillars algorithm, our method has made significant improvements in the 3D AP index. The average detection accuracy of car, Pedestrian, and Cyclist categories has increased by 0.99, 2.03, and 2.37, respectively, compared to the original algorithm. From this, it can be seen that the improvement of the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Motion Planning and Optimal Control of AEB System under Different Adhesion Coefficients Road
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To reduce the incidence of rear-end accidents of vehicles under different road surfaces, the Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) system under multiple road surfaces was conducted. First, the motion planning containing the warning signal phase and the emergency braking signal is proposed based on the vehicle condition artificial potential field method. Secondly, the fit and convergence speed of the particle swarm optimization PID (PSO-PID) controller is comparison of conventional PID controller, comparison of the results concluded that the PSO-PID maximum braking deceleration at the fit is high, faster convergence, there is better stability, can be achieved in the vehicle control system to achieve better deceleration effect. Finally, a joint simulation is performed using Carsim/Simulink on a low, medium and high adhesion coefficient road surface to test the validity of the control strategy. The test results indicate that using the control strategy proposed in this paper, the safe distance of parking is between 1.25-2.56 m, the stop time is in the range of 3.54-5.31 s, and the vehicle successfully stops and avoids collisions on three types of road surfaces mentioned above.

Author Keywords: Artificial Potential Field of Vehicle Condition

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Aircraft Engines based on FA-SDAE-BiGRU
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient feature extraction and inaccurate prediction in existing aircraft engines remaining useful life prediction algorithms, a fusion model based on feature attention mechanism, stacked noise reduction autoencoder and bidirectional gated cycle units (BiGRU) was proposed. Firstly, weight is assigned to each sensor data of aircraft engine by the feature attention mechanism, and new weight data is obtained. Next, the stack noise reduction autoencoder is used to extract the weighted data. Then, bidirectional gated recurrent units are employed to predict the time series data and obtain the remaining useful life of the aircraft engine. To accurately select the hyperparameters of BiGRU, the Bayesian optimization algorithm is utilized for hyperparameter optimization. Finally, ablation experiments were conducted on the CMPASS dataset to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, resulting in a root mean square error and score of 13.51 and 252.61, respectively.

articleTitle: Delay and Energy Consumption Optimization Method for Dependent Task Unloading
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: By deploying sufficient resources at the edge, applications with low latency and high energy consumption can be offloaded to the edge server for execution, reducing the total application execution cost. The existing unload models usually assume that several tasks of the application are independent of each other, and they often have dependencies in the real world. In view of the contradiction between the above research and reality, firstly, considering the limited edge server resources and battery capacity, this paper establishes a joint optimization model of delay and energy consumption (total cost) for dependent task unloading. Secondly, to solve this model problem, a Modified Sparrow Search Algorithm (MSSA) is proposed. To solve the problems of premature convergence, easy to fall into local optimal and poor global search ability in SSA, reverse learning, neighborhood search and Wolf pack algorithm are introduced to improve the algorithm. Finally, simulation results show that compared with other algorithms, the total application execution cost of the proposed algorithm is reduced by 7%~18%.

articleTitle: Research of Image De-noising Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Image denoising is a technology to restore the image by changing the information before and after the image sequence. The restored image will become very clear, and it is used a lot now. Due to the imperfect equipment, when the image is transmitted, it will be affected by noise, thus losing the original details. In order to solve this problem and make the noise image clear and obvious, this paper proposes an image denoising method based on deep learning, and constructs the image denoising network structure based on convolutional neural network. At the same time, the directional propagation algorithm is optimized to speed up the training speed of the model and effectively improve the denoising effect. By comparing the experimental data of the classical algorithm experiment, it is concluded that this study has achieved a better denoising effect. Finally, the key issues of image denoising research are summarized, and the development trend of future research in this field is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Health Management (PHM) is a comprehensive method and strategy that aims to monitor, diagnose and optimize the health status and performance of systems, equipment or components. It includes health monitoring, fault diagnosis, and remaining service life (URL) forecast. Among them, URL is a more important field in PHM. Because the physical knowledge used by precise modeling machines is complicated, data -based driving methods based on learning data have become a promising alternative method for model prediction methods. This article proposes a new time convolutional neural network (TCN) with a soft threshold and attention mechanism for mechanical prediction. The method used in this paper avoids the process of complicated artificial extraction, and uses bearings directly as the input of the network model. A soft threshold mechanism is added to the TCN network, so that more useful information is retained in the activation function ReLu. The threshold is self-adaptive learning by the sub-network trained by the channel attention mechanism, not the certainty value of the threshold distribution. Therefore, under the influence of the attention mechanism, each feature diagram has its own threshold, which retains some key features. On behalf of verify the generalization of the method proposed, the three benchmark data sets related to rolling bearings were tested, and the performance of the development method was compared with several advanced prediction methods. The results show that the development of all three cases has produced accurate RUL predictions, and has good robustness and generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: Research on Network Voltage Analysis Algorithm for Power System Transient Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to evaluate the stability and efficiency of power network, this paper analyze the stability of the power system with the main method which is the differential algebraic equations by alternating iterative. To overcome the shortcoming, an analytical method for solving the network voltage closed solution is proposed for different load models. This method can decouple the differential equation and the algebraic equation in the mathematical model. The mathematical model of transient stability analysis is transformed from the differential-algebraic equations to total differential equations without the alternating iteration of the solution process. This method can be used to calculate the effect of power system fault transient on the grid voltage within a certain period after the system fault, so as to quickly calculate the system voltage after the fault within 5ms-20ms of the protection action and 60ms-80ms of the circuit breaker removing the fault, which is a total time of 100ms Based on the solution of the network voltage, the quickly calculating short-term voltage while the system fault is proposed. The simulation results show that the method can quickly and accurately calculate the short-term voltage after the system fault.

articleTitle: Construct and Analysis of Metal Cutting Tool Remanufacturing Service Model
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Manufacturing is the pillar industry of the national economy, and remanufacturing is an important direction for the manufacturing industry to move towards greening, but the current research lacks a macro analysis of the tool service model. Given this problem, this paper first analyzes the current situation of metal cutting tool remanufacturing service mode. Then, the cause and effect analysis of the remanufacturing service model was carried out through Vensim PLE software. Finally, based on the above analysis, the remanufacturing service model is qualitatively analyzed and improvement strategies are proposed, which can promote the sustainable development of the tool remanufacturing market and increase the corresponding service revenue.

articleTitle: Research on the Cloud Flash Knot Platform Based on Yolov5 Item Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This project developed a fast payment method called "Cloud Flash Payment" utilizing YOLOv5 object detection technology. The system can detect the products customers are holding and display the price, which, combined with facial recognition technology, enables quick payment. Customers can complete the payment simultaneously while selecting the products. Compared to traditional object detection algorithms that rely on feature extraction and model training, YOLOv5 is extensively trained on large datasets and can quickly and accurately detect various objects, greatly improving the efficiency and accuracy of unmanned payments. In actual tests, unmanned payments using YOLOv5 can complete all payments within a few minutes, saving 10% or even less of the original time compared to traditional electronic payment methods. Its advantages are particularly apparent in areas with high foot traffic.

articleTitle: Research on Denture Feature Matching Point Cloud Data Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the vigorous development of modern science and technology, to effectively solve the shortcomings of traditional oral diagnosis and treatment, digital oral diagnosis and treatment models are based on three-dimensional reconstruction technology to restore the surface information of denture models, making it easier for doctors to accurately diagnose and treat patients' conditions. Deep learning provides new ideas for denture point cloud feature matching. In this paper, the EdgeConv structure is introduced to improve the network for denture point cloud matching. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the improved network for matching features of denture point clouds performs well in comparison to the traditional ICP algorithm. Compared with the PCRNet network, the MSE_R is reduced by 0.716, and the MSE_t is reduced by 0.064. The improved network has stronger feature extraction capabilities for local features, resulting in point cloud registration outcomes that are closer to the actual point cloud registration. Additionally, the network's performance is more consistent and stable.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation with Enclosed Automatic Mobile Factory for UHV GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The installation of ultra-high voltage GIS of enclosed mobile workshop is a new type equipment installation for outdoor GIS. In the fully enclosed environment onsite, it overcomes the impact of external environment on GIS installation and ensures the quality. Based on the background and the structural, it forms the application method in the engineering situation. The fully enclosed mobile factory installation of ultra-high voltage GIS has been tested and promoted in some provinces in the east of China. The total length of the Anhui power transmission project is 656 kilometers, and the substation capacity is 21 million KVA. The Zhejiang-Fuzhou ultra-high voltage AC transmission and transformation project has a total length of 2×603 kilometers, a substation capacity of 18 million KVA, and the whole line is erected with the same tower and double circuit. They have been determined to be widely used in all subsequent ultra-high voltage AC projects and achieving very good results.

articleTitle: A Novel Texture Mapping Method for Fringe Projection Profilometry
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Simultaneous acquisition of texture and depth is an urgent need in applications such as heritage preservation, medical and virtual reality. A phase guided texture mapping method for fringe projection profilometry (FPP) is presented in this paper. For texture acquisition, a color camera is introduced into the monochrome camera-projector FPP system. The projector projects both horizontal and vertical fringe patterns onto the object. Then the monochrome camera and color camera capture the deformed fringe patterns simultaneously. Based on the principle of FPP, the monotonically increasing horizontal and vertical phases can be retrieved from the distorted fringe patterns captured by cameras. Each point on the object has a unique phase pair which includes a horizontal phase value and a vertical phase value. The imaging points to the object point in monochrome camera and color camera have the same phase pair. This helps to find the corresponding point in color camera to the monochrome camera. The new mapped color texture can be calculated by interpolation after the corresponding point found. We studied the theory of this phase guided texture mapping method and present the experiment result. The result shows this method is robust and accurate.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Epidemic Prevention Sanitizer Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Based on ROS, this paper studies the key technologies of epidemic prevention sanitize robots, proposes the software and hardware architecture of epidemic prevention sanitize robots, and studies the map construction, positioning and navigation technologies based on SLAM technology. In order to improve the accuracy of algorithm mapping and positioning, the Cartographer SLAM algorithm is used to complete the construction of the environment map. The A* algorithm is improved, and the Hybrid A* algorithm is used to improve the efficiency of road path planning. The algorithm is verified in the school environment, and the results show that the robot mapping and positioning accuracy is improved by 27%, which can meet the needs of complex environments such as schools and hospitals.

articleTitle: Multi-objective FJSP Based on Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Flexible job shop scheduling problem is the core problem in the actual production of the intelligent manufacturing industry. To solve the problem of process sequencing and machine scheduling in multi-objective flexible job shop scheduling, a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm is proposed. Shortening the maximum completion time and reducing machine load as the optimization objectives, the objective function is transformed into a problem that can be solved by reinforcement learning. The state, action, and reward functions are established. The Q-learning method is introduced to propose a multi-agent reinforcement learning optimization algorithm. The algorithm is applied to the Brandimarte benchmark example for simulation verification. Compared with other intelligent algorithms, the algorithm has a faster convergence speed and higher utilization rate of the processing machine. Using this algorithm to solve the MK01 example, the minimum maximum completion time is 40. The feasibility, accuracy and efficiency of the intelligent optimization algorithm proposed in this paper are verified.

articleTitle: Construction of Knowledge Graph for Special Machining
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Special machining refers to the general term of processing technology which does not belong to the category of traditional machining technology. The data sources of special machining knowledge are various and rich, including structured, semi-structured and unstructured data sources. According to the characteristics of multi-source heterogeneous knowledge of special machining, this paper uses the powerful semantic machining ability and data organization ability of knowledge graph to solve the problem that the knowledge of special processing is difficult to be mined, so as to create the knowledge graph of special machining and realize the effective fusion and alignment of multi-source heterogeneous data. Therefore, this article uses technologies such as knowledge acquisition, knowledge integration, and network crawlers, and adopts a special processing knowledge diagram from the top - down graph construction model, which realizes the visualization of the Neo4j -based map, making special processing knowledge more intuitive and complete.

Author Keywords: Classify the Information of Non-traditional Machining

articleTitle: Hidden Markov-based Pilot Condition Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Pilot condition monitoring is crucial in aviation operations to ensure flight safety and pilot well-being. This study investigates a pilot condition monitoring method based on Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) and eye movement information. Eye movement information, as an essential physiological indicator, provides unique insights into a pilot's visual attention and cognitive processes. By analyzing eye movement data, it is possible to infer the pilot's condition and potential risks. The application of Hidden Markov Models in pilot condition monitoring is significant as it transforms eye movement data into hidden states and infers transition probabilities between states, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 92.46%.This study further explores methods for learning and optimizing model parameters to enhance pilot gaze perception. Pilot condition monitoring based on Hidden Markov Models and eye movement information has broad practical applications and potential impact, preventing accidents and offering essential guidance for personalized training programs, pilot scheduling, and operational process design. This research provides a foundation for further improvements and optimizations in pilot condition monitoring methods, contributing to improved aviation safety and pilot performance.

articleTitle: Optimized Spatio-temporal Feature Representation Based on 3D-CNN Motor Image Decoding
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The traditional convolutional neural network decoding model lacks the multi-domain information of electroencephalogram (EEG), which makes it difficult to decode motor imagery (MI) accurately. To solve this problem, this study proposes a 3D-CNN MI decoding method with optimized spatio temporal feature representation (OSTFR). Specifically, we utilize L21-norm optimization to generate a spatial filter set that captures highly distinguishable MI features in the multiband spatial domain. Secondly, with the sample covariance moments and spatial filter sets, the OSFR is generated by fusing the EEG time-domain and frequency-domain information. Finally, a new 3D-CNN model is designed to extract OSTFR features to complete MI decoding. Using the BCI Competition IV datasets 2a and 2b, which are available to the public, the value of the proposed method is verified, leading to decoding accuracies of 87.24% and 80.63%, respectively. The experimental results emphasize this method's potential for widespread use in BCI research by demonstrating its exceptional performance in MI decoding tasks.

articleTitle: Investigating Transformer-based Approach for Small-sample Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Object detection algorithm has gained broad attention, being recognized as an essential tasks within the realm of computer vision. Visual Transformer is an image analysis framework that uses a technique called the attention mechanism to process images. Unlike conventional convolutional neural networks, vision Transformer adaptively captures features at different scales in an image. In this design, the importance of context information with respect to the current location is calculated by vectorization representation and weighted at the decoding stage. With the introduction of this self-attention mechanism, the vision Transformer can realize end-to-end image processing while making maximum utilization of the global information within the image. However, it lacks the inductive bias inherent in convolution, which results in more data being required for training, usually pre-training on a large dataset, the JFT-300M, or at least ImageNet. Therefore, this paper studies the dependency of Transformer model on large-scale datasets. Firstly, in the neural net diagram, Fine-grained convolutional attention module CBAM method is introduced into the CNN architecture and trained together with CNN to Boost the model's performance. Simultaneously, an efficient Pre-training by reconstruction mechanism is adopted to reduce the dependence of Transformer based target detection methods on large amounts of labeled data. The upgraded algorithm has made progress in both the COCO dataset and the PASCAL VOC dataset.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the network environment is more open, and the ensuing information security has become a problem. Therefore, the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology is applied in network information security to build a more robust security protection system. This paper introduces three aspects in detail: Agent technology, intelligent firewall, malicious email detection. As an Agent technology, the agent technology can reduce the running time while ensuring the security of the network environment, and make a more quick response to the security threat situation. Intelligent firewall technology to achieve anti-attack, anti-scanning, anti-attack, intrusion, packet scrub and other five main protection technology, combined with the actual application scenario design of the specific architecture, simulation can reach 100% of the protection ratio, combined with the distributed design idea, more able to achieve "active sharing" of "intelligent learning" requirements, the indicators are good performance; There are various algorithms in artificial intelligence E-mail detection technology, and the mainstream algorithms have good performance in relevant statistical indicators. One of the new detection algorithms combining static features and dynamic features can achieve a detection rate of 99.7%. While the development of science and technology promotes the progress of The Times, new technologies also bring new challenges to network security. Under the new era and new needs, artificial intelligence technology has greater development space in the field of network information security.

articleTitle: Real-Time Voice Command Recognition System Based on DTW and MFCC
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Voice command recognition is an important research direction in the field of intelligent speech. Its task is to detect and recognize a given set of command words in continuous speech streams. For command recognition tasks with a voice command vocabulary, this article establishes a real-time voice command recognition system based on DTW and MFCC, using Python tools, to meet the requirements of real-time command recognition tasks. Firstly, the system processes the real-time collected voice based on dynamic time warping (DTW), and then uses the Deep Neural Network (DNN) as a feature extractor to extract the MFCC feature vector of the voice, and calculate the Euclidean distance between the feature vectors of the test voice and the template. The experimental results demonstrate that the real-time speech command recognition system based on DTW and MFCC has comprehensive performance advantages, which can meet the application scenarios of real-time control of speech commands and free users' hands.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Scheduling Research for Edge Servers
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The rapid development of the Internet of Things and big data has brought about massive amounts of data and the need for real-time responses, which traditional computing models can no longer meet. Edge computing comes into being, which pushes computing resources and services closer to the source of data generation so that data can be processed and analyzed closer to the user. The scheduling of siting strategies for edge servers is crucial for improving the performance of edge computing networks. Traditional scheduling methods for siting strategies are often based on rules or optimization algorithms, which lack adaptive and intelligent management of the network environment.This paper proposes a reinforcement learning DQN-based edge server siting policy scheduling method, which aims to achieve intelligent management and resource optimization of edge computing networks by learning the optimal policy. Experimental results show that the method has significant performance advantages in terms of delay, load balancing and energy consumption. The experiment adopts DQN algorithm, which is based on Q-learning and guides the agent to make decisions by optimizing Q-value function. In this paper, the reinforcement learning scheduling algorithm of edge server is studied and compared with other three algorithms. According to the experimental results, the proposed reinforcement learning scheduling algorithm reduces the delay by 7%, the energy consumption by 3%, and the load balancing by 20% compared with the other three algorithms. This shows that the algorithm has significant advantages in improving system performance.

articleTitle: Integrating Star Graph and Dynamic Intent Awareness for Session-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: A session-based recommendation model combining star graph and dynamic perception is proposed to solve the problem of remote information, ignoring the dynamic change of users' interests and the inaccurate expression of short-term preferences. Construct star graph and obtain remote node information by using Graph neural network. Then, the dual gating mechanism is used to integrate the information of item, time and user, and establish the dynamic interest model of user. Improved adaptive fusion mechanism, combining remote node information with users' dynamic interests to get global preferences. Improve short-term graphs and enhance recent interactive representations with global information for more accurate short-term interest. Compared with the optimal benchmark model, HR@20 reaches 54.29% at the highest, an increase of more than 2.1 percentage points, and MRR@20 reaches 18.84% at the highest, an increase of more than 0.9 percentage points, which verifies that this method can better match the real intention of users.
